quick_skim.title: Flash-CNNCap: Capacitance Extraction via Image Mapping
quick_skim.abstract: We present Flash-CNNCap, a CNN-based capacitance extractor that reformulates full-matrix capacitance prediction as image-to-image regression over spatial contribution maps. Prior scalar CNN-based extractors require $O(n^2)$ forward passes to recover all pairwise capacitances in a window with $n$ conductors. Flash-CNNCap replaces the scalar target with dense contribution maps: a total-capacitance model and a master-conditioned coupling model each predict a spatial map that is reduced to conductor-level values through mask aggregation, cutting full-matrix reconstruction to $O(n)$ passes. The resulting totals and symmetrized pairwise couplings define the corresponding Maxwell-style capacitance matrix under the standard off-diagonal sign convention. The maps are learned from conductor-level labels without per-pixel supervision. An ablation study over 13 model configurations selects a U-Net that matches ResNet baselines on total capacitance (1.5-3.1% MARE) and achieves the strongest coupling accuracy (3.0-4.6% MARE) across all evaluated CapBench subsets, with a $17.5\times$ full-matrix speedup on windows containing 134 conductors on average. A deployed pipeline reads Design Exchange Format (DEF) geometry and writes Standard Parasitic Exchange Format (SPEF) output, processing 1,024 windows in 51.23 seconds with a $4.4\times$ speedup over OpenRCX on the same benchmark. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/THU-numbda/flash-cnncap.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes Flash-CNNCap, a CNN that predicts full capacitance matrix from spatial maps, reducing forward passes from O(n^2) to O(n).
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对传统电容提取效率低的问题，本文提出Flash-CNNCap，利用卷积神经网络将电容矩阵预测转化为图像到图像的回归，通过总电容和耦合电容模型预测空间贡献图，再经掩膜聚合得到导体级电容。该方法将前向传播次数从O(n^2)降至O(n)，显著提高了提取速度，并保持了精度。该工作可用于互连寄生参数提取和串扰分析。

quick_skim.matched_query_text: Papers central to BGA焊球互连建模、串扰分析及等效电路提取相关预印本论文检索, especially work that connects or combines: PEEC package modeling; equivalent circuit modeling; parasitic capacitance inductance; near-end far-end crosstalk; package PCB interconnect; BGA package crosstalk; papers on PEEC or reduced order modeling for package and interconnect analysis; papers on near end and far end crosstalk analysis using capacitance and inductance extraction; papers on equivalent circuit or matrix based modeling of local package interconnect parasitics; papers on crosstalk modeling for BGA or package to PCB interconnect structures in high speed digital systems.
